name: Berry Avenue 🏠 RP
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Berry Avenue! A place to roleplay, hang out and explore!
🍓 Choose from a wide selection of stylish houses, cool cars & roleplay items to enhance your experience!

🏫 Become a student at the High School 🧑‍🏫
🏪 Work at the grocery store 🥔
🏦 Rob the bank or become a police officer 🚨
🏥 Treat patients at the hospital 🚑
& much more!

Genres: Roleplay, Town & City
